build-android.template: Run the full Android Gradle build: ./gradlew build

build-ios.template: Build the iOS app. First run: ./gradlew :shared:linkDebugFrameworkIosSimulatorArm64 -PenableIos=true. Then cd iosApp && pod install && xcodebuild -workspace iosApp.xcworkspace -scheme iosApp -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16' build
build-ios.description: Build iOS app via Gradle + CocoaPods + Xcode

pod-install.template: Run pod install in the iosApp directory: cd iosApp && pod install

test.description: Run all unit tests across all modules

lint.description: Run Android lint code quality checks

build-shared.template: Build only the shared KMP module for Android: ./gradlew :shared:build
